_comment: The harnesses Brigade ships a package for (card 110). The documentation gate (make docs-check) requires, for each entry, the member pages docs/team-member/{install,join,update,configure,leave}/<id>.md, the agent page docs/agent/in-a-team/<id>.md listing every skill under <skills>, and a <package>/README.md that links to the install page. Add an entry with the package; the gate names what is missing. status (work item 378, ADR 0022) is one of "Primary", "Supported, with known gaps" and "In trial": the install root, the harness's install page and its package page each show it on a line that begins "Status: ", and the install page of a harness that is not Primary says what the status means for it under "## Known gaps" or "## In trial". It is set from evidence and read again before each release (docs/developer/release/cut-a-release.md).
